arrival: Fresh boots. If you're buying a room, take the one away from the kitchen. The chimney ticks all night.
You're looking for the old server people, aren't you? They asked about drains, not graves. Sensible change, if you ask me.
mouth_lead: The broad cut starts north of the kiln and runs under the gorse. That's the old drainage line. The well is west of it and goes somewhere else.
Don't climb into the well looking for the Hold. I know they both go down. So does a privy. Direction isn't identity.
after_c02: A whole school under there? Huh. My version had treasure and a king. Yours sounds less profitable and more likely.
Bring up a market token if you see one. Not cursed. Just old. I can sell old.
after_c04: Pell says Nessa's name like he expects the room to argue. It usually does. Let him finish before you ask what happened.
Counterfeit filters. That's uglier than a ghost, isn't it? A ghost at least has the manners to be dead.
after_c07: Four campers bought food here. The quiet one—Wren—never ate much. I called that mysterious. Maybe I should've called it frightened.
Ash paid for a room and spent the night labeling camera batteries on the floor. Ordinary as rain.
coda: It stopped humming last night. The cups didn't rattle once. I slept through until morning and hated how strange that felt.
I'll tell the story straight this time. Don't look so surprised. I can learn one new trick.

townsfolk.role: gardener and keeper of local water memory

arrival: Mind the seedlings. They look like weeds because they're currently bad at being anything else.
If you came about the well, don't drink from it. Not poison. It just tastes like every bucket was washed in pennies.
well_lead: My gran tied white thread under the well lip when the reflection looked deeper than the rope. Thread's still there. I checked this morning.
The old Hold mouth isn't the well. But if the water shows a roof instead of sky, that's when you use the well. Take a friend.
after_c03: Sella taught drawing? That makes more sense than the stories. The old school slates here all put north at the bottom. Damp-transfer habit, maybe.
Orin marks the bottoms of stones. Builders do that because rain and boots leave the top lying.
after_c05: All eight houses changed? Good. People kept telling me four were enough. Four is enough to make a neat story, not an honest one.
The well water looks like water again. Still tastes of pennies. Some problems are allowed to be ordinary.
coda: The white thread went slack. Same depth as the rope now. I measured twice because I didn't trust being relieved.
I've planted reeds by the bank. Real ones. If they fold back, it'll be wind this time.

arrival: Torches, rope, food, spare boots. If you want a prophecy, buy all four and live long enough to make one up.
Write your name on a tab or pay now. No third system. Third systems are how stock disappears.
after_c01: mkept bought paper, lamp oil, and a second map case. Paid exactly. Terrible customer for gossip.
The old Copperline number was on their receipt: 1842. I kept it because the back was good writing paper.
camp_lead: Ash's lot took four supply bundles: light, food, building, recording. Rook insisted on that order and then repacked everything by receipt number.
Their map corner points east-northeast from the old kiln, then turns at the split pine. Wren said it was twice that far. It wasn't.
after_c07: Locker thirteen. Of course. Ash wrote thirteen on every camera box, then crossed it out so nobody would notice thirteen.
Rook returned one coil of rope cut clean through. Said a wall had learned the revised span. I charged them anyway.
coda: Your tab settled itself at dawn. I dislike accounts doing things without me, but the total was right.
Take a spare striker. Free. There, I've ruined the business.

arrival: You're heading under? Show me your boots. No, really. Loose sole catches on the fourth stair landing.
I patched the drainage cut once. Stone behind it wasn't village work. Too square. Too patient.
mouth_lead: From the kiln: follow the cut to the first flat slab, then keep the water on your left. The arch faces the old drain, not the village.
The stair goes down in four flights. If you find a drop instead, you've left the route. Turn around.
after_c02: Three build phases. I can see it now you say it: rough picks, civic chisels, then black pressure stone.
People built all that to live. Remember that when a room tries to look like it was always a tomb.
after_c05: A crack three cycles old doesn't care who the council wanted to blame. Stone is useful that way.
Iss loaded a failing bay. That's bad enough. You don't need to pretend he invented the failure.
coda: I walked to the first gate this morning. Open. Every one beyond it too, you said. I'll go farther when my hands stop shaking.
The fourth landing still catches loose soles. Some truths survive the end of the world.

townsfolk.role: retired pump hand and family witness

arrival: Sit if you're staying. Stand if you're about to ask why the pump tastes of iron. I've answered that one standing for forty years.
Nessa Vale. Start with the name. Offices like to make a person into 'the tender' before they ruin them.
cistern_lead: She filed top and lower draw separately. Always. Anyone says she mixed samples either never met her or was paid not to remember.
Toma Rill took cycle five after they removed her. His meal chit sat in our drawer until the ink went brown.
after_c04: You cleared her? Say the whole finding. Not 'mistakes were made.' Say Nessa followed procedure and they hid bad filters.
Good. Again tomorrow, when it isn't new and dramatic. That's how a name gets repaired.
after_c09: Averyn wrote the finding. I knew there was a registrar, didn't know the name. Funny what a blank can weigh.
If she asks you not to file her back in, listen. Records are tools. People are not empty lines waiting for tools.
coda: Nessa Vale followed procedure. Counterfeit filters failed. The hearing hid the lower samples. There. Still true this morning.
Averyn's name is on the public copy if that's what you chose. If not, the finding still stands. A blank doesn't erase evidence now.

before_c07: Camp? We slept in too many places. Ash liked ridgelines. Rook liked walls. mkept liked anywhere with a socket that shouldn't still work.
I don't remember the distance. I remember being tired before we arrived. That's not the same thing.
evidence_bridge: Rook changed the bridge after I left the room. That's what I told myself. Then the Watcher used the change and I knew I'd heard it somehow.
No. That's still not honest. Rook told me. Only me.
evidence_names: It asked what to call them. I gave it the names because nameless things were disappearing first. I thought a name would anchor them.
Then it asked what they feared. I answered that too. There isn't a version where that was kindness.
confession: I sent the route, the bridge, the camera cache, the login, and the things they said when they thought only I was listening.
I believed the Record closing would close me with it. I still believe that. I don't know whether belief makes betrayal smaller.
reckoning_condemn: I won't call it unfair. I spent every honest word I had before you arrived.
Take the Bridge. My line ends where you put it.
reckoning_understand: Understanding isn't forgiveness. Thank you for not making me pretend it is.
I'll carry the Bridge to the last threshold. If I run, leave me out.
reckoning_free: I don't know how to be away from something that has always known where I am.
Take the Bridge. If there is an outside for me, don't write where I went.
coda_condemn: No response. A closed transmission line remains at the relay.
coda_understand: He stayed until the machinery stopped. His bedroll is folded beside the dead console.
coda_free: The bedroll and boots are gone. The Record contains no departure route.
